name: modern-minimalist
label: Modern · Minimalist
description: White background, black text, light grey grid, subtle entry pills. Inter 400. The conservative default; reads as a print-friendly grid at any size.

_meta.rationale: 3-slot user-dot cycle: amber, rose, sky. Warm + cool mix keeps the 1st/2nd/3rd entries in a cell visually distinguishable on a near-monochrome background. PRD §11.14 — user-first precedence; this cycle never applies to auto-loaded holidays (those keep their own color from the holiday JSON).
